title: Right Left Through or Swing
author: Mattie Rynkiewicz
problems: The progression after row 7 "left diagonal right left through, partner swing if no one is there" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 4 have not passed each other yet.
Row 1 "balance & petronella · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 1 "balance & petronella · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.

Row 3 "partners balance & swing, end in short waves with larks facing in, robins facing out · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: The eight cannot reach those places as couples.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
